# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_PULLBACK_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large gap-ups that open above VWAP often fade as intraday sellers push price back to VWAP, providing a short opportunity. This fade occurs because initial gap-up enthusiasm exhausts, and value-seeking sellers enter, driving price toward the VWAP as a fair-value magnet. The strategy targets the first 30 minutes of trading when this mean-reversion tendency is strongest.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If pre-market gap >0.8% up (calculated from prior day close to pre-market open) AND price at 09:35 ET is > VWAP +0.3% AND the 5-min bar ending at 09:35 shows a bearish close (close < open) with volume > average 5-min volume (using prior 20 bars), enter short at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the high of the gap bar (the bar that opened the gap). Profit target 1 at 1R (distance from entry to stop). If TP1 hit, trail remaining position with a chandelier exit using 1.5× ATR (ATR calculated over 20 periods).  
**Regime filters:** Only trade when VIX > 18, between 09:30-10:30 ET, and avoid Mondays and Fridays.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% of headline P&L (based on 3-contract minimum at $1K).  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample would be all SPY days meeting VIX>18 and time filters from 2025-01-02 to present; selection method is mechanical gap/VWAP/volume criteria; overfit risk exists due to regime-specific gap behavior (may not persist in low-vol regimes).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed yet).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic simulator run on top 3 J days).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: gap continuation instead of fade (e.g., strong bullish news causing sustained run-up); max drawdown scenario: consecutive gap-up days triggering multiple stopped-out shorts; blow-up scenario: gap-up during black-swan event causing limit-up moves beyond stop.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate concentration without backtest results).
